name: asc-app-create-ui
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: A paid Apple Developer Program account.
An Account Holder, Admin or App Manager role, and the Account Holder has signed the latest agreement.
The user's own signed-in browser session; Apple offers no API for creating app records.
risks: Creates a permanent app record; its pause before Create covers standalone scripts only (SKILL.md:26), so stop before Create and ask.

appleText.reason: An 18-word quote, attributed in place, of Apple's note that new apps are created on the App Store Connect website, not through the API.
